target_customer: Patent holders, licensing and litigation teams, patent attorneys and M&A diligence teams
problem: Granted patents are expensive to maintain and often unused. Patent Watch interprets patents, finds likely infringing products and generates claim charts to support licensing, litigation and diligence.
business_model: B2B SaaS, likely per seat or per project (not confirmed)
product_category: Legal tech, AI patent analysis and infringement detection

founders.name: Alexander Stroe
founders.background_notes: YC page bio says he previously day traded funded accounts and spent over $1M on ads; education not listed.

founders.name: Andreas Stroe
founders.background_notes: Brother of the CEO per YC page.

competitors.name: Solve Intelligence
competitors.what: AI patent drafting and prosecution platform that launched Charts for litigation and competitive intelligence in December 2025
competitors.traction_then: Reported $12M ARR in Dec 2025 per Sacra

technical_complexity.rationale: Mapping claim language to product evidence with LLMs and producing defensible claim charts is standard AI engineering with hard accuracy and trust requirements.

defensibility.rationale: Workflow and legal deliverable trust help, but larger patent platforms and well funded rivals can bundle similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals added claim chart features during 2025; no acquisition of Patent Watch found as of late 2026.

market_need_then: Patent owners spend up to $50k per patent over its life per the company pitch, and claim charts are costly manual work; licensing monetization and AI legal tooling interest rose in 2025.

identity.logo: unclear; site asset filename suggests a placeholder logo
identity.voice_and_tone: Revenue oriented: turn your patent portfolio into revenue in 10 minutes

brand_strength.rationale: Generic descriptive name that overlaps with older patent watch services; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Patent Watch, a Fall 2025 YC company, is active in late 2026 and reported a $2.8M seed in April 2026 led by FundersClub, with its own site stating $3.2M raised in total. The extra raise within months of the batch suggests investor interest, but a crowded patent AI field with funded rivals is the main risk and no exit has occurred.
notes: Seed of $2.8M on 2026-04-01 appears in Sacra and startupresearcher (2026-04-03), investors also include MyAsiaVC, Asymmetry Ventures, Team Ignite Ventures and No Talking Capital per Sacra. The company site says it has raised $3.2M, consistent with a $400K pre-seed, but aggregators conflict on the pre-seed (400K per Sacra and Signalbase, 500K in 2025-12 per VCBacked, CB Insights total 900K), so it is not recorded as a round. Competitor search found little dated material; Solve Intelligence's date is the Charts launch, within the batch window. The site fetch showed placeholder stats and the YC page differs from the site on SEP focus. Company page gives no founder education.
